answer: Each submission hangs on the quill of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
